spec.abstain_behavior: Return should_call_tool false when visible reminders are missing, selection is ambiguous, reminder_id is missing, or required update fields are absent.
spec.description: Reminder CRUD action bridge. Use after search_reminder returns visible reminder records, or when add_reminder kwargs are already known. It selects one latest/oldest/upcoming reminder when requested and returns final original ToolSandbox add/modify/remove reminder kwargs. It never performs side effects.
spec.generalization_rationale: Reminder CRUD tasks repeatedly need a final-action bridge from visible reminder records or converted timestamps to preserved original reminder side-effect calls.

inadequacy_evidence.summary: Without a dedicated canonicalizer, agents often miscompute dates because they lack consistent local-midnight anchoring and offset handling (e.g., mixing UTC vs local-day boundaries), producing timestamps off by whole days or hours.

inputs.description: Visible reminders returned by search_reminder, or [] for add_reminder.
inputs.name: reminders

inputs.description: add_reminder, modify_reminder, remove_reminder, add, modify, update, remove, delete.
inputs.name: action_type

inputs.description: latest, oldest, upcoming, first, last, or blank when there is exactly one reminder.
inputs.name: selection_mode

spec.reason_tool_is_decisive: It converts a unique visible reminder or known add reminder fields into exact preserved reminder kwargs.
shortfall_cluster_evidence: reminder CRUD/scheduling bucket had 36 tasks with 24 no-visible-helper cases in the post-scale gap assessment
reminder pilot20 top-v2 showed visible-not-called select_record_by_timestamp_extreme on 8/20 while relative timestamp helpers provided small positive natural value
current helpers often stop at timestamp/record selection rather than final add/modify/remove reminder kwargs
